description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) achieved under strong and weak supervision for three different models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The horizontal axis displays the model names, arranged in no particular order, while the vertical axis represents performance gain in percentage, with a linear scale from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5. For each model, two bars are shown: a striped bar for strong supervision and a solid light purple bar for weak supervision. The performance gain for GPT-4o is approximately 20% under strong supervision and 8% under weak supervision. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the gains are around 12% and 6%, respectively. Qwen2-72B-VL achieves approximately 18% under strong supervision and 7% under weak supervision. The bars are not sorted by value and show no additional visual emphasis beyond their distinct patterns. A legend at the top of the chart clearly distinguishes the two supervision types by their bar styles.
